correctness.rationale: Explicit hollow bistochastic X(P) has nonnegative entries and row/column sums one for all n>=3 and fixed-point counts, and row/column potentials certify the exact global projection normal inequality. Exact summation gives k+k(k+2)/(n+k^2-2); strict derivative gives shell ordering, transposition second shell and gap 2, with all-body uniqueness by convexity. Conjugacy averaging plus unit-circle singular values proves all-Schatten Hausdorff sharpness. Schatten strict convexity, trace bounds and spectral equality establish nearest locus including all nuclear minimizers and their affine dimension. Exact arithmetic tests cover 5910 permutations (n=3..7) and independent optimization 18 cases; these finite computations corroborate the complete proof.

value.rationale: The zero-diagonal doubly stochastic face is an intrinsic matching polytope of the crown graph and approximating all assignments by forbidden-self-matching assignments is natural. The new result gives an all-dimensional complete discrete Frobenius distance spectrum, exact shell frequencies, a uniform sharp top gap and Hausdorff diameter, plus a genuinely structural nearest-point nonuniqueness transition from strictly convex Schatten norms to the nuclear norm. These complete metric/optimizer classifications are independently motivated and not incidental substitutions.
